svg.title: Offset pagination versus cursor pagination
svg.desc: Page size 5. Page one shows posts 40 to 36. Three new posts arrive. Asking for offset 5 returns 38, 37, 36 again plus 35 and 34. Asking for posts older than 36 returns 35 to 31 with no repeats.
svg.text: page size 5; 3 new posts arrive before page 2
